rationale: tools/scripts/package_cli.py now also searches the job-local FetchContent source and base dirs (PULP_SHARED_FETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR / PULP_FETCHCONTENT_BASE_DIR) for the wgpu-native runtime, ahead of the shared home caches. Release CLI isolates each signing job into a fresh root, and the Linux packaging step could not find the runtime CMake linked from there. Only the lookup order for one runtime library changes. No design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging authority moves, and the packaged file set is unchanged.
